body:
I think this should not be changed. The purpose of the brackets is to ensure that the lock is only held for the following line of code. 

Currently, that line of code is the last line of code in the block, so this change won't change current behaviour. But it does change the semantics of the function. 

With the suggested change, we change from "hold this lock during this one line of code" to "hold this lock for the rest of this block". 

The former makes it safe and easy to extend or refactor this block as needed. The latter creates a hidden trap for future maintainers
